# criblio_commit (Resource)

Commit Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_commit" "my_commit" {
  effective = true
  files = [
    "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/http_input/conf.yml",
    "groups/default/local/cribl/routes.yml",
  ]
  group = "default"
  message = "Update Route and Pipeline for HTTP Sources"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) Commit message to use for the new Git commit.

### Optional

- `effective` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, apply the commit to the group's effective configuration. Requires a group context.
- `files` (List of String) Array of file paths to include in the commit, relative to the configuration root. If omitted, all pending changes are committed.
- `group` (String) Worker Group to commit changes for.

## Import

Import is not supported for this action resource.
